name: connect
description: Connect to SSH server (Linux/Debian) or initialize PowerShell/WinRM target computer with automatic ~/.ssh/config resolution and Ed25519/RSA multi-key support

alias.description: Optional session alias for multi-host management

key_passphrase.description: Passphrase for encrypted SSH private key

key_path.description: Path to SSH private key (supports Ed25519, RSA, ECDSA)

port.description: SSH port (default: 22 or resolved from config)
